name: comp-107
blurb: Four-option text alignment toggle group with primary-colored buttons.
description: A ToggleGroup with four mutually exclusive text alignment options: left, center, right, and justify. Initializes to center and uses primary background colors.
use_when: Selecting text alignment in a text editor or content formatter.
avoid_when: When multiple alignments could be active simultaneously or when primary color is not appropriate.
a11y: Uses aria-label on each toggle item and aria-hidden on icons. ToggleGroup manages selection state and keyboard navigation.
